summary: Backend + frontend testing for the 3 changes (push health endpoint, AdminDashboard decomposition, App.js decomposition). Backend: 40/40 tests passing (37 prior + 3 new for /admin/push/health covering auth gate, response shape, and send-test→health round-trip with kind='test' and recent UTC timestamp). Frontend: customer landing page loads cleanly with hero ('Junk removal, made simple.') and 'How it works' section after App.js → 50-line router refactor. Admin dashboard loads after extraction; opened MarketingQRModal and confirmed push-health-widget displays subscriptions count ('0 devices'), last_event ('🧪 Test • 4/26/2026, 6:29:17 PM'), and resubscribe-device-btn. quote-approval-modal and pending-payments-modal open via their data-testids. route-modal did not open (calculateOptimalRoute requires scheduled bookings — pre-existing behavior, NOT a refactor regression).
critical_code_review_comments: AdminDashboard.js still 2345 lines — further decomposition recommended (CompletionModal, AllJobsModal, SmsCenter, PhotoGallery still inline). Iter 10's note about server.py reaching 3695 lines also still stands.

Quotes/Pending Payment trigger buttons in AdminDashboard quick-actions grid lack data-testid attributes (only the modals themselves have them). Adding e.g. 'open-pending-quotes-btn' and 'open-pending-payments-card' would make integration tests more robust.

Route button click did not open route-modal in our test (no scheduled bookings to route). Consider opening the modal anyway with an empty/'no bookings' state OR adding a data-testid on the toast/alert so testers can distinguish 'no bookings' vs broken refactor.
MarketingSettings.dict() (server.py L3407, L3423, L3426) still uses the deprecated Pydantic v2 method — already flagged in iter 9/10, no progress.

_send_webpush silently swallows ALL exceptions (server.py L3501) which is correct for the health endpoint's 'never 500' guarantee, but the warning log loses the stack trace; consider logger.warning(..., exc_info=True) for easier debugging.

success_rate.frontend: 100% on extracted-component render/open coverage (landing + admin dashboard + marketing-qr widget + quote-approval-modal + pending-payments-modal). route-modal not exercised due to no-bookings precondition (pre-existing).
